subject: Question about purchase note
text:
I am following up on the portable microscope purchase that the team submitted last Monday. The vendor has sent a confirmation number, but the item description does not match one instruction in the original requisition. Under supplies, the note says “standard replacement bulbs, ordered as discussed.” I searched the project folder and found two separate emails: one requested four bulbs for the teaching station, while another proposed a trial pack because the old models may not fit. Since I was not part of that conversation, I cannot tell whether to receive the full set or the smaller one. If we receive the wrong quantity, the finance office will ask us to explain the discrepancy. Could you clarify which option should stand, and whether the old bulbs should be returned immediately? I can call the vendor after I have your answer, and I will copy the lab technician so that the delivery is inspected rather than stored incorrectly. Thank you for helping us resolve this before the weekend shipment cutoff. If it would be quicker, I can join your office hours and bring both emails. I will keep the confirmation on hold until clear approval.
Thank you,
